question.text: Rebalancing enables 'automatic' buying low and selling high, hence is a:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook identifies the constant-mix approach as the rebalancing process, which sells appreciated assets and buys depreciated assets to restore target weights. The Trap: Momentum strategies add to trends, which is the opposite of the constant-mix rebalancing process. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook, p.396-397, p.400, p.315-316.
